text: Hello and welcome back to another week
of I Racing. You join us for GT3
hot lap this time at Oran Park. And yes,
that is right. It's Oran Park. Not sure
I've ever been here before. If you are
looking for more detailed breakdown, we
did do them for the Porsche, the
Ferrari, and the Mustang. But the
braking markers are exactly the same.
There's not many of them. Anyway, if you
want to race the exact setup being
driven by Jan Lutsow in this hot lap,
you can go to the website being shown on
Any questions, let me know in the
comments. But please note the track
conditions and track times, as always,
are shown in the obliques. Enjoy.
